notes: §1985:VI.4.3.2 prints the paragraph as the header SOURCE-COMPUTER and its period, then one bracket holding computer-name, an optional WITH DEBUGGING MODE and the second period (printed page VI-10 rendered: the period stands inside the bracket). The grammar rule sourceComputerParagraph implements every arm but one: the header alone is the empty paragraph; a computer-name (a word) may be followed by debuggingModeClause (WITH optional, DEBUGGING and MODE required), which VersionConformancePass.VisitDebuggingModeClause admits below 2014 and DebuggingLineRewriter.DeclaresMode reads to compile the unit's debugging lines; the clause is reachable only after a name, so a name-less WITH DEBUGGING MODE is refused; anything else after the name is the error production ClosedFormatPass.VisitUnrecognizedClause refuses (COBOL1970); and ClosedFormatPass.ScreenParagraphPeriods refuses a name or clause with no closing period (COBOL3408). Missing: the grammar's final period is optional whatever precedes it, and ScreenParagraphPeriods returns when ParagraphPeriods.Sentences finds no sentence, so SOURCE-COMPUTER followed by two periods and no computer-name is accepted at 85. That spelling is the 2023 format's (§2023:12.3.5.2 prints the second period outside the bracket and §2023:12.3.5.3 SR1 lets it be omitted); the 1985 bracket gives the second period only with a computer-name, and §1985:IV.4.2.1 rule 3 allows a period only at a sentence's end "or as shown in formats". The screen has no 1985 arm. The witness writes XYZ-1 WITH DEBUGGING MODE and shows its debugging line compiled. Probed at --std 85: the empty paragraph, a name, the clause with and without WITH and over three lines are accepted; the clause without a name, DEBUGGING without MODE, WITH alone, MODE alone, two names, the clause twice, a literal or an integer as the name, a missing period after the header, the name or the clause, the paragraph twice and after OBJECT-COMPUTER are refused.

next.reason: 1985: "SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name [ WITH DEBUGGING MODE ] . ]"; 2023: "SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name-1 ] .". 2023 keeps the paragraph and the optional computer-name, but its format no longer has WITH DEBUGGING MODE, so 1985 programs using that phrase are refused.
